statement: The labium tip is a flat at least 0.45 mm wide
rationale: A slicer drops or widens whatever is thinner than its minimum feature, so a modelled knife edge prints truncated and the cut-up grows by an amount the slicer decides: 0.7 to 1.4 mm on a 25 degree ramp for a minimum feature of 0.3 to 0.6 mm (input fdm-whistle-printing-notes, section 2.1, which asks for an explicit flat of 0.45 to 0.50 mm). 0.45 mm is one line at the configured width. Whether a blunt 0.45 mm edge voices as well as a sharper one is untested (same notes).

mechanism.how: The width of the flat on the labium tip, read from the model.
